responsibility: Implements the ISO CHAR classification predicates with direct ASCII-range tests and whitespace/control checks. It provides the concrete lexical helpers used by conversion and scanning modules such as LongConv and related text-processing code, turning individual CHAR inputs into basic category decisions without involving the broader I/O subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation of CharClass: unlike CharClass.def, it realizes the declared predicates with direct character-range and whitespace/control checks using ASCII constants.
